moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ui-island, written here): Black pill at the top of a phone frame: width 80 → 240 and height 26 → 60 px with radius = height / 2, driven by k = spring(k260 c22) from 0.3 s minus spring(k260 c26) from 2.1 s (≈ 500 ms open, 400 ms close). Content (accent circle r14 at the left, two text bars) fades in as k goes 0.6 → 1 and out the same way before the shrink completes. Params: size (80x26 → 240x60) · open (k260 c22) · close (k260 c26) · hold (1.8 s) · radius (½ chiều cao). Width 80 → 240 and height 26 → 60 (shown at half size on the 320 frame), the radius always half the height; content fades in as the spring passes 0.6.
